info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Collateral Allocation Management API
info.description: The Collateral Allocation Management API provides essential capabilities for managing and monitoring collateral allocations within a banking environment. It allows users to access detailed information regarding collateral distribution and availability, ensuring efficient management of risk and assets. This API is particularly useful for financial analysts, risk management teams, and portfolio managers who need to make informed decisions based on real-time data. By leveraging this API, institutions can optimize their collateral usage and enhance their overall financial operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about collateral allocation management, providing insights into the status and organization of collateral assets.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the necessary parameters for retrieving collateral allocation information. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the allocated collateral data.
